items.title: Akamai Strikes $11.6 Billion Deal With Anthropic
items.summary: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has made an $11.6 billion deal with cloud infrastructure firm  Akamai  for its computing services for the next seven years, Akamai announced, with an option to expand the deal by another $9 billion if more compute is needed.  Akamai stock rose more than 18% to $130.83 in after-hours trading on the news.  The deal will “support Anthropic’s accelerating CPU workload demands by leveraging Akamai Cloud’s distributed AI infrastructure and software,” Akamai said.
